summary: Gyomu Infrastructure (gyomu-infra) is a core infrastructure package providing robust utilities and services for file and stream I/O, structured CSV processing, filesystem manipulation, and database persistence via SQLAlchemy. It also encapsulates domain-specific infrastructure concerns such as business calendar calculations, market holiday repositories, and parameter translation services.
responsibilities: Provide core infrastructure and utility components for data parsing, file handling, and stream processing.
Implement persistence operations, database connections, and transaction management using SQLAlchemy.
Support domain-specific calculations and translations including business calendars, holidays, and variable resolution.
Provide system integration helpers such as logging, process execution, configuration loading, and hashing.

capabilities.name: CSV Data Processing
capabilities.description: Read, write, and parse structured CSV data and configuration models using Pydantic validation.

capabilities.name: Filesystem Operations
capabilities.description: Provide robust file system operations including file I/O, searching, enumeration, and exclusive access handling.

capabilities.name: Stream Processing
capabilities.description: Support lazy stream processing and byte stream I/O utilities for handling pipeline data.

capabilities.name: Variable and Parameter Resolution
capabilities.description: Resolve and translate date and parameter placeholders to support dynamic execution context.

capabilities.name: Business Calendar Services
capabilities.description: Perform business calendar calculations and market holiday services using cached repository instances.

capabilities.name: Database Infrastructure
capabilities.description: Manage relational database connections, transactions, and SQLAlchemy-backed repository models.

design_decisions: Leverages SQLAlchemy as the persistence layer with explicit transaction management and repository patterns.
Integrates Pydantic for robust data validation across configuration and structured file parsing.
Utilizes functional error handling and lazy evaluation patterns via the returns library and record streams.
Encapsulates domain-specific logic such as business calendars, parameter masters, and market holidays within structured infrastructure modules.
usage_guidance: Import file I/O, CSV parsing, and stream processing utilities from their respective submodules for data ingestion and export pipelines.
Utilize SQLAlchemy repositories, transaction managers, and connection factories for interacting with relational databases safely and consistently.
Leverage the business calendar and variable translation modules when implementing date-sensitive domain operations and parameter resolution.
